events.title: Noosa Alive! Festival
events.datetime: Mon 20 Jul - Sun 26 Jul, various times
events.description: A comprehensive arts and culture festival in Noosa Heads, featuring a diverse program of ballet, comedy, theatre, literature, and film, held across various intimate venues and outdoor spaces.

events.title: Open Studios Sunshine Coast
events.datetime: Mon 20 Jul - Sun 26 Jul, 10:00 AM - 4:00 PM
events.description: An opportunity to visit local artists in their creative studios across the Sunshine Coast region, observe demonstrations, and potentially participate in hands-on workshops.

events.title: The Curated Plate
events.datetime: Fri 24 Jul - Sun 2 Aug, various times
events.description: A 10-day celebration showcasing the Sunshine Coast's finest local produce, innovative producers, and talented chefs through one-off dinners, degustation menus, and unique producer experiences.

events.title: Introduction to Mindfulness and Meditation
events.description: An introductory session to mindfulness techniques and meditation practices, offering guidance for those looking to begin or deepen their journey into mindful living.

events.title: T.R.E Tuesdays
events.description: A recurring weekly session focused on Tension, Trauma Releasing Exercises (TRE), a self-help technique designed to release chronic tension and stress through gentle body movements.

events.title: Social Volleyball Games - Meridan State College ALL Levels
events.description: An inclusive social volleyball session open to players of all skill levels, offering a chance to meet new people, get active, and enjoy friendly games in a community setting.

events.title: Your Mates Brewing - Friday Knock Offs
events.description: A casual social gathering at Your Mates Brewing, perfect for unwinding after the week, meeting new people, and enjoying local brews in a relaxed community atmosphere.

events.title: Mudjimba Night Markets - Saltwater Saturdays
events.description: A vibrant local night market featuring stalls from local artisans and food vendors, offering a family-friendly atmosphere for community gathering in Mudjimba.

events.title: STOICISM SUNSHINE COAST
events.description: A regular meetup for discussing Stoic philosophy, providing a space for thoughtful conversation, reflection, and applying ancient wisdom to modern life in a natural setting.
